title: Ensure login via local UNIX Domain Socket is configured correctly
rationale: Restrict local socket authentication to trusted users and use secure authentication methods.
remediation: Review pg_hba.conf and ensure local connections use secure authentication methods such as scram-sha-256. Remove any unnecessary trust authentication.

title: Ensure login via host TCP/IP Socket is configured correctly
rationale: Restrict network authentication to authorized hosts using secure authentication mechanisms.
remediation: Review pg_hba.conf (or cloud parameter configuration) and ensure only trusted networks are allowed. Use scram-sha-256 authentication whenever possible.

title: Ensure Password Complexity is configured
rationale: SCRAM-SHA-256 provides stronger password security than MD5 and protects against modern password attacks.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET password_encryption = 'scram-sha-256';
SELECT pg_reload_conf();
